claims: Anthropic gives a one-time $100 or $250 credit for Claude Code cloud sessions; claim by 11:59 PM PT Oct 7, credit expires 11:59 PM PT Nov 4 (on screen)
Setup took the creator under a minute: click claim link, connect GitHub, done
Cloud sessions keep running with your laptop closed, and keep going even after you hit a local rate limit, until the credit runs out (on screen)
how_to_steps: Open the claim link (claude.ai/code/claim-credit/...) or run /claim-credit in Claude Code
Start a cloud session from the CLI (claude --cloud), desktop app, web (claude.ai/code) or the mobile app's Code tab

relevance.why: Free credits and the cloud-session feature are directly useful for a time-poor founder who wants long-running Claude Code work while away from the laptop. However the claim window (Oct 7) has already passed as of Oct 10, 2026.

implement_score.why: The credit itself is likely expired; the durable takeaway is to use 'claude --cloud' / claude.ai/code for background sessions on our repos. Five minutes to check /claim-credit in case the offer was extended.
